meta.title: Cancelling the drawer discards the draft counter offer
gaps: The fixed prepared state has only one vendor with a bid; opening vendor A's drawer and then a distinct vendor B's drawer requires a second vendor and active bid.
Vendor B's quoted values and empty remark after cancelling vendor A's edits cannot be observed in this state.
The no-raise-call oracle cannot be asserted without the counter-offer request path, which is not supplied by the catalog or case.

steps.note: Open the existing RFQ with its single active vendor bid.
Open the available vendor's counter-offer drawer.
Enter a draft counter price without sending it.
Cancel rather than send the counter offer.
Reopen the same vendor's drawer as the closest available check; this is not vendor B.
Check the available vendor's quoted price against the prepared API value.
Check the reopened remark field against an empty value; this does not establish cross-vendor isolation.
Record the reopened drawer for inspection, including whether the remark is truly empty.
